content: lazygit: Go TUI. No native side-by-side diff — delegates to custom pagers (delta, ydiff) via config. | key cycles pagers. Diff pane not its own dedicated viewer; it is embedded in the git management UI. Supports diffing branches/commits. Layout has fixed panels making large side-by-side difficult. Custom pager support not available on Windows. Navigation within diff is pager-dependent.
